spec.title: Add greenfield support to festina-create-project
spec.context:
festina-create-project assumes an existing codebase with product and engineering docs. For greenfield projects (no code, no docs, no tasks), users have no viable path. festina-define exists but is too tedious — it asks 30-50 granular questions and produces temporary docs that get rewritten during finalize. Users end up not using festinalente for new projects at all.
This task makes festinalente a complete tool for both greenfield and brownfield projects by enhancing /festina-create-project with AI-driven research that fills the knowledge gap an existing codebase would normally provide.

in-scope.item: Greenfield detection in festina-create-project (empty product/engineering dirs)
Adaptive vision capture with 2-4 broad questions for greenfield flow
4 parallel research agents (stack, features, architecture, pitfalls) for greenfield
AI-proposed versioned requirements (v1 MVP / v2 future / out-of-scope)
Research findings stored in project.xml <research> section
Complete removal of festina-define skill (source, installed, product doc, config, directive rule)
Graceful cancellation and agent failure handling

out-of-scope.item: Changes to festina-scope or festina-plan (they passively read project.xml already)
Generating product/engineering docs during create-project (that's what downstream skills do)

delta.current:
festina-create-project follows a linear flow: title capture, Socratic Q&A (problem, value, scope, requirements, acceptance criteria), product/engineering doc search, requirement validation, decomposition into 2-5 tasks, user confirmation, file creation. It searches for existing product/engineering docs but has no alternative flow when none exist.
festina-define is a separate skill for greenfield projects that asks 30-50 granular questions across product vision, features (depth-first), engineering stack, systems, patterns, conventions, then generates product/engineering docs and a glossary. It is referenced in config.yaml, git.xml (G-DEFPROD rule), install.cjs, README.md, and has a product doc at skills/define-product.
delta.changing:
festina-create-project gains a greenfield detection step after title capture. When greenfield is detected, the flow diverges to: (1) adaptive vision capture with 2-4 broad questions, (2) 4 parallel research agents, (3) AI-proposed versioned requirements, (4) decomposition from v1 only. The brownfield path remains identical. Research findings are stored in a new <research> section in project.xml.
festina-define is removed entirely — source, installed skill, product doc, config entry, directive rule, and all references.
delta.unchanged: The brownfield flow (existing product/engineering docs) remains exactly as-is. Socratic Q&A pattern for brownfield. Task decomposition logic (2-5 vertical slices, requirement coverage). project.xml structure (aside from new <research> section). All Handlebars partials. Downstream skills (scope, plan, implement).

contract.name: Greenfield detection and vision capture
contract.postcondition: If greenfield detected, vision capture completes with 2-4 questions; if brownfield, existing flow runs unchanged
contract.invariant: Greenfield detection is deterministic based on product/engineering dir contents
contract.property: No regression — brownfield projects always follow the existing flow

contract.name: Parallel research agents and tech validation
contract.precondition: Vision capture completed with user's input (title, optional tech prefs, MVP scope)
contract.postcondition: 4 research agents complete (or gracefully degrade on failure); findings stored in project.xml research section
contract.invariant: All 4 agents always launch regardless of user input
contract.property: When user said "unsure" about tech, stack agent proposes options; when user specified tech, stack agent validates/augments

contract.name: Versioned requirements and decomposition
contract.precondition: Research findings available from all successful agents
contract.postcondition: Requirements proposed as v1 (MVP) / v2 (future) / out-of-scope; decomposition uses only v1 requirements
contract.invariant: v2 and out-of-scope requirements are stored but never decomposed into tasks
contract.property: Every v1 requirement maps to at least one task; task count is 2-5 (or user-approved if 6+)

contract.name: Cancellation and agent failure resilience
contract.precondition: User is in any step of the greenfield flow
contract.postcondition: On cancellation, no project or task files created; on agent failure, flow continues with remaining results
contract.invariant: No partial state (orphan files) left on cancellation
contract.property: At least one agent failing does not block the flow; user is informed which research was unavailable

requirements.requirement: The system shall detect greenfield projects by checking whether .festinalente/product/ and .festinalente/engineering/ directories contain no substantive docs (only overview.md or empty counts as greenfield)

When greenfield is detected, the system shall present an adaptive vision capture with 2-4 broad questions: what are you building, what tech (or "unsure"), what's MVP vs out-of-scope, and an optional free-form question (skippable)
After vision capture, the system shall launch 4 parallel research agents (stack, features, architecture, pitfalls) using the Explore subagent pattern with WebSearch capability

When the user said "unsure" about tech choices, the stack research agent shall propose options with pros/cons for user validation; when the user specified tech preferences, the agent shall validate and augment rather than replace
Research findings from all successful agents shall be stored in a nested <research> section in project.xml with subsections for stack, features, architecture, and pitfalls
After research completes, the system shall propose requirements versioned as v1 (MVP), v2 (future), and out-of-scope, with user validation before proceeding
Task decomposition shall use only v1 (MVP) requirements; v2 and out-of-scope requirements are stored in project.xml but not decomposed into tasks
When existing product and engineering docs are found (brownfield), the existing create-project flow shall run unchanged with no regression
When the user cancels during vision capture Q&A, no project or task files shall be created and no partial state shall remain
When a research agent fails or returns no results, the flow shall continue with remaining agent results and inform the user which research was unavailable
When the user provides very minimal input (just a title, skips all questions), the system shall use AI judgment to propose requirements based on the title alone and mark all requirements as inferred

The festina-define skill shall be removed entirely: source (apps/festinalente/src/content/skills/festina-define/), product doc (skills/define-product), config.yaml mapping, G-DEFPROD rule in git.xml, and all references in install script and README

pattern.name: Parallel Research Agents
pattern.description: Launch 4 Explore subagents in parallel via Task tool, synthesize results. Established pattern in festina-scope for deep research.

pattern.name: AskUserQuestion Dialogue
pattern.description: One question at a time via AskUserQuestion tool with header, options (2-4), and "Other" for free input. Used across all festina skills.

pattern.name: Handlebars Skill Compilation
pattern.description: Skills use {{> partial-name}} syntax compiled by tools/build.ts. Partials provide shared content blocks.

product.finding: Current skill assumes brownfield — Socratic Q&A for problem/value/scope/requirements, doc search, auto-decomposition into 2-5 tasks. No greenfield path.
Separate greenfield skill asking 30-50 granular questions. Too tedious — users avoid it. To be removed entirely.
